messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Meadowbrook private VPC — internal NLB target group 'mb-app-tg' failing health checks in us-east-1. Elevated 5xx rate at customer endpoints. Pager: @ryan.

ryan: I'm oncall, ack. tagging network + infra. quick check — scope/impact?

maria: support: Meadowbrook seeing ~30% 502/503s since 08:12 UTC. Affects production traffic routed through their private deployment (dedicated pool). No control-plane loss reported.

alex_net: pulling target health now. aws cli dump below. one node flapping, NLB returning 502s when requests land on it.

```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:targetgroup/mb-app-tg/abcd1234
{
  "TargetHealthDescriptions": [
    {"Target": {"Id": "10.2.4.12", "Port": 8080}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Reason": "Health checks failed"}},
    {"Target": {"Id": "10.2.4.13", "Port": 8080}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "healthy"}}
  ]
}
```

alex_net: p95 latency spiked during flaps, p50 OK. sounds like a single backend is causing 5xx fanout.

eli: quick mitigation: remove flapping target from TG to stabilize. will deregister 10.2.4.12.

ryan: proceed. if that drops errors we'll do replacement. keep me posted.

eli: deregistered 10.2.4.12 from mb-app-tg.

```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=10.2.4.12
```

eli: metrics — 502 rate dropped to <1% within ~90s. Traffic looks steady.

maria: customer confirms endpoints mostly responsive now (~95% success). Some residual errors but trending down.

alex_net: dug into instance logs — OOM killed the app process on 10.2.4.12 after a memory spike from scheduled batch. snippet: 

```
[08:11:57] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (app) score 823 or sacrifice child
[08:11:57] kernel: Killed process 2345 (app) total-vm:...kB, anon-rss:...kB
```

ryan: plan: keep bad IP out of rotation, spin a replacement from the reserved dedicated pool, register once healthy. Eli — deploy replacement, timebox 15m.

eli: launching instance from mb-app-v2 AMI in subnet a. will run health checks and register when green.

julia-oncall: taking the handoff at 08:37 UTC. I'll own comms and close coordination.

sean-pm: drafting customer note: "We've mitigated an availability issue impacting Meadowbrook's private deployment. We're investigating root cause and will provide RCA." Approve? :thinking:

maria: approve. include impact window 08:12–08:35 UTC, ~30% of requests affected, no data loss.

eli: new instance 10.2.4.22 is up and passing health checks. registering now.

```
aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=10.2.4.22,Port=8080
```

eli: registration accepted; TG shows target healthy. load now balanced across healthy targets.

alex_net: SGs unchanged — inbound from NLB to app:8080 allowed. app logs on new node show normal startup; no OOM. recommend keeping 10.2.4.12 out until patched.

ryan: agree. do not reintroduce 10.2.4.12. open remediation ticket to cap batch job memory and add OOM watcher alert + target-flap alarm.

julia-oncall: customer notified. they replied: "Thanks — please share RCA and mitigation timeline." I'll coordinate a follow-up.

maria: severity S2. assigning RCA to ryan + alex_net. RCA due in 48h. remediation owner: eli.

ryan: noted. remediation actions: add cgroup memory cap for batch jobs, alert on target unhealthy count >1 and auto-deregister, and add post-deploy memory regression test.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3098 marked mitigated (resolved state for now). Duration 00:23. Responders: ryan, eli, alex_net, maria, julia-oncall.

julia-oncall: closing thread — will reopen if errors reappear. :white_check_mark:
